key_highlights: Iron ore crash confirmed, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX and ASX200 materials weight
Oil price spike from Red Sea Houthi escalation lifts energy names but pressures inflation and RBA path
Global AI selloff (Anthropic warning) drags tech sentiment; limited ASX direct impact but risk-off mood
ANZ.AX completes 3,500-job cut; restructuring progress uncertain, weighing on financials
Australian housing: no spring bounce, falling prices, young buyers cautious — REITs and construction under pressure
ASX treads water as Fed meeting and oil volatility dominate; AUD under pressure from commodity weakness
Exploration positives: Critica 19Mt tin-tungsten, Forrestania 2Mt gold, Sarytogan 97.7% graphite yield support small-cap miners
Major private hospital operator in financial collapse — healthcare sector consolidation risk
Immigration policy debate intensifies; Joyce dismisses 'tanked economy' fears but productivity concerns persist

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot and Trump regime-change dynamics weigh on pricing. However, exploration wins (tin-tungsten, gold, graphite) provide small-cap support.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Small-caps CRX.AX, FRT.AX, SRY.AX benefit from discovery news. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Oil spike from Red Sea Houthi escalation; Australia nears energy inflection point. Fuel blowout pressures Albanese for excise cut. TMK Energy gas flows surge in Mongolia.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from higher oil. Fuel cost inflation pressures consumer and transport names. RBA may delay cuts.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post 3,500-job cut faces execution risk. Housing weakness (no spring bounce, falling prices) pressures NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX loan growth. Elevated Treasury yields support net interest margins.
sectors.implications: Financials mixed: NIM support vs. credit and growth headwinds. ANZ.AX restructuring is a key near-term catalyst.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator in financial collapse and division. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor but sector consolidation risk emerges.
sectors.implications: Watch for M&A opportunities in private hospital space. CSL.AX, SGH.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) offer relative safety.

sectors.trend: Housing auction market flat, prices falling, caravan manufacturer shuts, steelworks job losses. Consumer confidence under pressure from fuel costs.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and rate sensitivity. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) defensive but margin pressure from input costs.

sectors.trend: Global AI selloff on Anthropic warning; Trump pushes 'whoever wins with AI wins.' Limited direct ASX tech exposure but sentiment spillover.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face sentiment drag. Australian AI infrastructure plays may see reduced global capital flows.

key_themes: Iron ore structural demand shift and China policy pivot
Red Sea shipping disruption and energy security
Australian housing market inflection and immigration-driven demand question
RBA policy dilemma: oil-driven inflation vs. slowing growth
Commodity exploration renaissance in WA and Tasmania
Financial sector restructuring and productivity concerns

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price crash and China demand deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weight; rotate into gold (NVS.AX, GSN.AX) and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Red Sea escalation driving oil spike and inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour energy producers; monitor RBA commentary for rate path

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market downturn and credit risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and construction; favour defensive financials with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global AI selloff and risk-off sentiment spillover
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash buffer; avoid chasing tech rallies; focus on earnings-driven ASX names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Immigration policy shift reducing labour supply and demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor construction and services sectors; favour productivity-led companies over labour-intensive models

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private hospital operator collapse and healthcare consolidation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid distressed healthcare operators; favour CSL.AX and listed health insurers

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil spike and Red Sea risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Sustained oil elevation supports margins; Australia's energy inflection point favours domestic producers

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and battery-material explorers amid iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash diverts capital to alternative commodities; WA/Tasmania exploration wins provide catalysts

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive consumer staples on housing and inflation concerns
opportunities.rationale: WES.AX, WOW.AX offer dividend yield and defensive characteristics in risk-off environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG by 20-30%
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash with China demand pivot; limited near-term recovery catalyst

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight REITs and construction; raise cash to 10-15%
defensive_moves.rationale: No spring bounce, falling prices, elevated rates; housing cycle turning negative

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid ANZ.AX until restructuring clarity; favour CBA.AX/NAB.AX in financials
defensive_moves.rationale: 3,500-job cut execution risk; ANZ grand plan 'long way to go'; peers better positioned

market_outlook.short_term: ASX200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. Oil volatility, iron ore weakness, and global AI risk-off cap upside. RBA on hold with oil-driven inflation. Fed meeting adds uncertainty. Expect 2-4% downside risk on ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA eases. Australia's energy transition and exploration pipeline offer structural support. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising. Productivity and immigration policy will define growth trajectory.
